title: Solana-only parameterized live-query contract and manual-query default
objective: Reconcile the Solana S1-S4 live-query UTC day with the D+1 14:00 UTC policy by using a fixed saved-query report_day parameter, and make manual query/no-send the default. Test-only Feishu delivery remains an explicit opt-in. This task does not provision credentials, create Dune resources, execute live queries, schedule delivery, or activate another chain.
owner_authorization: Owner authorizes the Solana-only parameterized query contract and confirms: test runs may send to the fixed Feishu test group; normal use is manual query only after an explicit Owner instruction and must not auto-send to Feishu. Solana remains the only active chain. A newly rotated DUNE_API_KEY and DATABASE_URL remain runtime-only external configuration for a later real-data run.
forbidden_actions: Do not read, print, write, commit, or include any credential, .env file, database connection string, browser state, token, cookie, or raw provider payload in a repository or run artifact.
Do not create, update, execute, or infer a Dune saved query; saved-query provisioning is a separate explicitly instructed runtime operation after this contract is GREEN.
Do not accept arbitrary SQL, arbitrary parameters, or arbitrary Dune query IDs. Only the S1-S4 Solana saved-query allowlist may carry the exact report_day parameter.
Do not schedule, auto-send, or expand delivery beyond explicit test-only Feishu sends. Normal use must remain manual query/no-send until an explicit Owner instruction.

Do not activate BSC, Four.meme, or Robinhood, and do not modify CA facts, holder cleaning, creator precedence, Dev behavior, wallet clusters, wallet-quality rules, sentiment facts, or recommendation/trading language.
